run_waymo_tfrecord_to_json: run the CLI to convert Waymo TFRecord files into Nocturne compatible JSON scenarios
run_parallel_conversion: run the Waymo TFRecord to JSON conversion split across multiple CPU processes
run_no_traffic_light_filter: run the Waymo JSON generator excluding scenarios that contain traffic lights
run_single_file_conversion: run the Waymo TFRecord converter on a single specified file and output to current directory
run_full_dataset_conversion: run the Waymo JSON generator to iterate through and convert the entire training or validation dataset
